plan.notes: Official term-by-term program map (Suggested Program of Study) for the ACS Certified Chemistry degree from the Valdosta State University Department of Chemistry and Geosciences (current map; course codes/titles verified against the current VSU undergraduate catalog on 2026-10-09). The map lists course titles; codes assigned from the catalog. All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (14/14/16/15/16/15/15/15); total 120 matches. Note: the map prints Year 2 Fall physics as 3 cr, but both PHYS 1111K Introductory Physics I and PHYS 2211K Principles of Physics I are 4-cr courses and the printed semester total is 16 (4+4+4+4); transcribed at 4 cr. Map milestones: 9 hours of Modern Foreign Language in core/electives; electives chosen to give 39 total upper-division hours, 6 of which must be other than chemistry. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
